verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated `writing-skills` meta-skill that walks the agent through authoring skills TDD-style: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the skill, watch tests pass, then refactor to close loopholes. That covers both writing and improving, and an eval harness judges skill compliance on real agent sessions. Packaging is only implied, via the skill's note on the cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` location. Missing for 10: explicit packaging/distribution guidance for new skills, independent or hands-on corroboration of the skill-authoring workflow.
